specs.name: 余烬·破垒
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one exquisite fantasy CROSSBOW weapon concept illustration for a Skyrim geometric luminous weapons collection. Single full crossbow, three-quarter overhead view, butt at lower left, transverse limbs at upper right, generous margin, dark charcoal background. Clearly readable shoulder stock, hand grip and trigger, bolt track and crosswise bowstring. Solid thick simple geometric beams and broad luminous planar surfaces, dimensional bevels, controlled emissive edges and sparse crisp particles. No realistic metal, wood, crystals, filigree, hexagrams, text, characters or scenery. Elegant manufacturable 3D forms, distinct strong silhouette, not a gun, not a handheld vertical bow. Moderate bloom preserves all shape detail. Red and rose-red light. Heavy siege-wedge design: two wide solid swept-back triangular wedge limbs forming a bold shallow angular V, each limb a single large beveled blade with one long triangular aperture, NOT a row of scales. Massive angular central cradle, short sturdy tapered open triangular shoulder stock, low-profile arrow track. A few small red triangular embers drift away from the outside limb tips. Aggressive compact architectural shape.
